Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If you don't delete this card, the part after "then" in its [All Turns] effect can't give you 1 memory.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [All Turns] effect without meeting the "by" condition?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[All Turns] When any of your Digimon with [Myotismon] in their names are played, by deleting this Tamer, 1 of those Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn. Then, gain 1 memory.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
